stem_book: A wheel (treat it as a uniform disc) of mass 10 kg and radius 20 cm is rotating at an angular speed of 100 rev/min when the motor is turned off. Neglecting the friction at the axle, calculate the force that must be applied tangentially to the wheel to bring it to rest in 10 revolutions.
reason: Added 'uniform disc' (I = MR²/2) — the key 0.87 N needs it; a ring would give 1.75 N.
